title: install-local: a composed app cannot be uninstalled — the app install is refused until its extending module is uninstalled, and the module has no install entry and is read-only
body:
### Edition

Open source, self-hosted runtime (Kubernetes)

### Version

`@objectstack/*` 18.5.0 (runtime and CLI)

### What happened / What you expected

A composed app installed through install-local cannot be uninstalled, by the API or from Setup → Installed Apps.

The app is one release artifact carrying six package bodies (ADR-0130 D4): the `type: app` package and five `type: module` packages; one module declares `objectExtensions` on three of the app package's objects. `os package install ./dist/objectstack.json` registers all six, but writes **one** install-local entry, for the app package id (`GET /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` lists only it).

Then the two doors refuse each other:

1. `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/<app id>` (also the console's **卸载 / Uninstall** button) → `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`:
   > Uninstall the package that extends objects of "<app id>" first (<app id>.carbon), then uninstall "<app id>" again: a package cannot be uninstalled while another package extends an object it owns (objectExtensions, ADR-0029).
2. `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/<app id>.carbon` → `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND "No marketplace install for <app id>.carbon."` — the module has no install entry of its own.
3. `DELETE /api/v1/packages/<app id>.carbon` → `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`: the module is read-only ("provided by code or an installed app").

So the prescribed order (module first, then the app) has no door that performs its first step, and the only remedy left is deleting the cached manifest under `storageDir` on the host and restarting.

**Expected:** uninstalling the install entry of a composed artifact uninstalls every package body it installed, in reverse dependency order (extending modules before the package they extend) — the same unit the install was. Equivalently, the extension check should not count extensions contributed by packages of the same install.

Related: #34336 (the same composed install loads none of the package bodies' seed datasets or translations), which is how we got here — the natural recovery, uninstall and reinstall, is blocked by this.

### Steps

1. Build a composed artifact where a `type: module` package extends an object of the `type: app` package (`objectExtensions`), e.g. any HotCRM-style suite with a module that adds fields to `crm_account`.
2. `os package install ./dist/objectstack.json --url <runtime> --token <key>`.
3. Setup → Installed Apps → Uninstall the app (or the three calls above).
4. Observe the 409 / 404 / 422 above; nothing can be removed.
